```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Resolve this Rmd's directory, then locate setup_publication.R from there.

  error = function(e) normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES <- c(

CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES <- unique(c(
  CURRENT_FIGURE_SOURCES,
  CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES
))

read_current_source <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES) {
    stop(
      "`", id, "` is not referenced by the current figures.Rmd or tables.Rmd. ",
      "Update CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES only after the report source files change.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  read_infographic_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}

read_current_figure <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_FIGURE_SOURCES) {
    stop("`", id, "` is not a current figure source.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  read_current_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}

read_current_table <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES) {
    stop("`", id, "` is not a current table source.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  read_current_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}


# ============================================================================
# GENERIC BY-THE-NUMBERS HELPERS
# ============================================================================

info_label <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))) return("—")
  as.character(x)
}

info_cell <- function(value, label, value_type, projected = FALSE) {
  if (!is.finite(value)) return("—")

  suffix <- if (projected) "P" else ""
  paste0(format_value(value, value_type), " (", info_label(label), suffix, ")")
}

metric_values <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    first_value,
    first_label,
    last_value,
    last_label,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    projected = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID   = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section  = section,
    Measure  = measure,
    Earlier  = info_cell(first_value, first_label, value_type),
    Latest   = info_cell(last_value, last_label, value_type, projected = projected),
    Change   = format_change(first_value, last_value, change_type),
    Emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

metric_series <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    df,
    column,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    year_column = "Year",
    academic = FALSE,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    transform = identity
) {
  first <- data_endpoint(
    df,
    column,
    which = "first",
    year_column = year_column,
    academic = academic
  )

  last <- data_endpoint(
    df,
    column,
    which = "last",
    year_column = year_column,
    academic = academic
  )

  first$value <- transform(first$value)
  last$value  <- transform(last$value)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = first$value,
    first_label = first$label,
    last_value = last$value,
    last_label = last$label,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

metric_snapshot <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    value,
    label,
    value_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID    = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section   = section,
    Measure   = measure,
    Earlier   = "—",
    Latest    = info_cell(value, label, value_type),
    Change    = "—",
    Emphasis  = emphasis
  )
}

metric_text <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    earlier,
    latest,
    change = "—",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID    = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section   = section,
    Measure   = measure,
    Earlier   = earlier,
    Latest    = latest,
    Change    = change,
    Emphasis  = emphasis
  )
}

latest_row <- function(df, year_column = "Year") {
  yr <- year_number(df[[year_column]])
  df[which.max(yr), , drop = FALSE]
}

first_last_year_labels <- function(df, year_column = "Year") {
  yrs <- year_number(df[[year_column]])
  yrs <- yrs[is.finite(yrs)]
  c(first = as.character(min(yrs)), last = as.character(max(yrs)))
}

finalize_infographic_data <- function(data, section_order) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data$Measure), nzchar(.data$Measure)) %>%
    mutate(
      Section = factor(.data$Section, levels = section_order),
      RowOrder = row_number()
    ) %>%
    arrange(.data$Section, .data$RowOrder)
}


# ============================================================================
# EDITORIAL LABEL CLEANUP
# ============================================================================
# Keep the section header responsible for the repeated concept ("international",
# "temporary visa holder share", "US universities in the global top 100", etc.)
# and keep individual measure labels short enough to scan in one line.

editorialize_infographic_data <- function(data, chapter_number) {
  out <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Section = as.character(.data$Section),
      Measure = as.character(.data$Measure)
    )

  if (chapter_number == 2) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "Where international students come from" = "Countries of origin",
          "Where international students concentrate" = "Fields and STEM concentration"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$SectionID == "origin" ~
            str_replace(.data$Measure, " share of international ", " — "),

          .data$StatID == "tab201_asia_count" ~ "Students from Asia",
          .data$StatID == "tab201_asia_share" ~ "Asia share",
          .data$StatID == "tab201_europe_share" ~ "Europe share",
          .data$StatID == "tab201_subsaharan_share" ~ "Sub-Saharan Africa share",

          .data$SectionID == "field" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, "^International students in ") ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^International students in "),

          .data$SectionID == "field" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, "^International STEM students from ") ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^International STEM students from ",
              "STEM students from "
            ),

          .data$StatID == "economic_contribution" ~
            "Contribution to the US economy",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing visa application process" ~
            "Visa application process",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing u.s. travel restrictions" ~
            "US travel restrictions",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing feeling unwelcome in the united states" ~
            "Feeling unwelcome in the US",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing social and political environment in the united states" ~
            "US social and political environment",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 3) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "International talent in the education-to-work pipeline" =
            "Education-to-work pipeline",
          "Which STEM graduates work in STEM" =
            "STEM graduates working in STEM",
          "Where temporary visa holders concentrate" =
            "Temporary-visa-holder share by occupation"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "pipeline_masters" ~ "Master’s students",
          .data$StatID == "pipeline_doctorate" ~ "Doctorate students",
          .data$StatID == "pipeline_opt" ~ "Optional Practical Training",

          .data$StatID == "postdoc_science" ~ "Share of science postdocs",
          .data$StatID == "postdoc_engineering" ~ "Share of engineering postdocs",
          .data$StatID == "postdoc_health" ~ "Share of health postdocs",

          .data$StatID == "stem_conversion_us" ~
            "US-born doctorate holders in STEM",
          .data$StatID == "stem_conversion_foreign" ~
            "Foreign-born doctorate holders in STEM",

          .data$SectionID == "degree_work" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, " employed in STEM occupations$"),

          .data$SectionID == "visa_concentration" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^Temporary-visa-holder share: "),

          .data$StatID == "ai_all_foreign" ~
            "All-foreign-born founder teams",
          .data$StatID == "ai_some_foreign" ~
            "Some foreign-born founders",
          .data$StatID == "founder_origin_1" ~
            "Largest immigrant-founder origin",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 4) {
    # Remove the redundant 2022 PISA-math snapshot because the time-series row
    # immediately above already ends at the same 2022 value.
    out <- out %>%
      filter(.data$StatID != "us_oecd_math") %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "Keeping STEM students in STEM" = "STEM persistence by field",
          "What Americans study abroad" = "Fields studied abroad",
          "Where Americans study abroad" = "Destinations abroad"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "us_math_gap" ~ "PISA math vs OECD average",
          .data$StatID == "us_science_gap" ~ "PISA science vs OECD average",
          .data$StatID == "us_reading_gap" ~ "PISA reading vs OECD average",
          .data$StatID == "us_top_math" ~ "Students at PISA math Levels 5–6",

          .data$StatID == "us_k12_spending" ~
            "K–12 spending and PISA math score",
          .data$StatID == "us_spending_ratio" ~
            "Tertiary-to-K–12 spending ratio",

          .data$StatID == "early_exit" ~
            "Left without return in first two years",

          .data$SectionID == "persistence" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, ": graduates remaining in entry field$"),

          .data$StatID == "tab401_stem_bachelors" ~
            "Completed a STEM bachelor’s degree",
          .data$StatID == "tab401_nonstem_bachelors" ~
            "Completed a non-STEM bachelor’s degree",
          .data$StatID == "tab401_left_no_degree" ~
            "Left with no degree",

          .data$StatID == "tab402_never" ~ "Never switched majors",
          .data$StatID == "tab402_multiple" ~
            "Switched majors more than once",

          .data$SectionID == "study_abroad" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^US study-abroad students in "),

          .data$SectionID == "study_abroad_region" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^US study-abroad students going to "),

          .data$StatID == "outbound_us" ~
            "United States — tertiary students studying abroad",
          .data$StatID == "outbound_china" ~
            "China — tertiary students studying abroad",
          .data$StatID == "outbound_india" ~
            "India — tertiary students studying abroad",
          .data$StatID == "netflow_us" ~
            "United States — net student flow (millions)",
          .data$StatID == "netflow_china" ~
            "China — net student flow (millions)",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 5) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "The institutional bench" =
            "US universities in the global top 100",
          "Patent leadership is shifting" = "Patent leadership"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "neurips_us" ~
            "US — NeurIPS oral-presentation authors",
          .data$StatID == "neurips_cn" ~
            "China — NeurIPS oral-presentation authors",
          .data$StatID == "topcited_us" ~
            "US — top-cited emerging-tech publications",
          .data$StatID == "topcited_cn" ~
            "China — top-cited emerging-tech publications",
          .data$StatID == "topauthors_us" ~
            "Top papers — US author",
          .data$StatID == "topauthors_cn" ~
            "Top papers — China-based author",
          .data$StatID == "researchers_us" ~
            "Top-1% most-cited researchers — US",
          .data$StatID == "researchers_cn" ~
            "Top-1% most-cited researchers — China",

          .data$StatID == "tab501_conference_us" ~ "Median US share",
          .data$StatID == "tab501_conference_china" ~ "Median China share",
          .data$StatID == "tab501_china_leads" ~
            "Conferences where China leads the US",

          .data$SectionID == "institutional" ~
            str_remove(
              .data$Measure,
              "^US universities in the global top 100: "
            ),

          .data$StatID == "rd_spend_us" ~
            "US spending (billions, 2020 PPP)",
          .data$StatID == "rd_spend_cn" ~
            "China spending (billions, 2020 PPP)",
          .data$StatID == "rd_intensity_us" ~ "US intensity",
          .data$StatID == "rd_intensity_cn" ~ "China intensity",

          .data$StatID == "basic_us" ~ "US basic research",
          .data$StatID == "basic_cn" ~ "China basic research",
          .data$StatID == "business_us" ~ "US business-sector R&D",
          .data$StatID == "business_cn" ~ "China business-sector R&D",

          .data$SectionID == "patents" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, "^US–China patent-grant gap: ") ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^US–China patent-grant gap: ",
              "US–China grant gap: "
            ),

          .data$SectionID == "patents" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, " US patent grants$") ~
            paste(
              str_remove(.data$Measure, " US patent grants$"),
              "patent grants"
            ),

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 6) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "Stay intentions by region of origin" = "Stay intentions by region",
          "Employment-based green-card wait times" =
            "Employment-based green-card waits"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "intend_stay" ~
            "PhD recipients intending to stay in the US",

          .data$SectionID == "regional_stay" ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^(.+): international STEM PhDs intending to stay in the US$",
              "\\1"
            ),

          .data$StatID == "tab602_computing" ~
            "Computer and information sciences PhDs",
          .data$StatID == "tab602_engineering" ~ "Engineering PhDs",

          .data$StatID == "tab603_tvh_academe" ~
            "Temporary visa holders — academe",
          .data$StatID == "tab603_tvh_industry" ~
            "Temporary visa holders — industry/business",
          .data$StatID == "tab603_us_industry" ~
            "US citizens — industry/business",

          .data$SectionID == "perm" ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^(.+): share of PERM certifications expiring unused$",
              "\\1"
            ),

          .data$StatID == "workforce_gap_us" ~
            "US immigrant workforce-participation gap",

          .data$StatID == "trained_total" ~
            "STEM doctorate recipients in cohort",
          .data$StatID == "trained_left" ~
            "Estimated no longer in the US after ~10 years",
          .data$StatID == "training_value_left" ~
            "Estimated US training investment that left",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  out
}


export_current_chapter <- function(
    data,
    chapter_number,
    title,
    subtitle,
    name,
    source_figures,
    section_order,
    note_text = NULL,
    rows_per_page = INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE
) {
  data <- finalize_infographic_data(
    data,
    section_order
  ) %>%
    editorialize_infographic_data(chapter_number)

  build_page <- function(
      page_data,
      page_number,
      total_pages,
      is_last_page
  ) {
    final_notes <- character()

    if (is_last_page) {
      if (!is.null(note_text) && length(note_text)) {
        final_notes <- c(
          final_notes,
          note_text
        )
      }

      final_notes <- c(
        final_notes,
        paste0(
          "**Source:** Derived from the current report figures and tables: ",
          paste(source_figures, collapse = ", "),
          ". See the cited figures and tables for full source information."
        )
      )
    }

    build_infographic_table(
      data = page_data,
      id = paste0(name, "_page_", page_number),
      chapter_number = chapter_number,
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      notes = final_notes,
      layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
      row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
      nowrap_values = TRUE
    )
  }

  exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
    data = data,
    build_page = build_page,
    name = name,
    rows_per_page = rows_per_page
  )

  knitr::include_graphics(
    vapply(
      exports,
      `[[`,
      character(1),
      "png_path"
    )
  )
}
```

# Chapter 1

```{r infographic_ch1_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ============================================================================
# CHAPTER 1: AMERICA'S STEM TALENT SYSTEM — BY THE NUMBERS
#
# Design:
#   - Page 1 = historical/current U.S. pipeline measures.
#   - Page 2 = global STEM PhD projections.
#   - Both pages use exactly the same typography, columns, row heights,
#     heading treatment, and physical width.
#   - Measure labels avoid repeating words already supplied by section headers.
#
# Current report sources only:
#   Figures 1.01–1.08 and Table 1.01.
# ============================================================================


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CURRENT REPORT SOURCES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

fig101 <- read_current_figure("FIG101") %>%
  select(Year, value = 2) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

fig102 <- read_current_figure("FIG102")
fig103 <- read_current_figure("FIG103")

fig104 <- read_current_figure("FIG104") %>%
  rename(Year = 1, Total = 2, Share = 3) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

fig105 <- read_current_figure("FIG105")
fig106 <- read_current_figure("FIG106")

fig107_long <- read_current_figure("FIG107") %>%
  pivot_observed_projected()

fig108_long <- read_current_figure("FIG108") %>%
  pivot_observed_projected()

tab101 <- read_current_table("TAB101")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DERIVED STEM COMPOSITION MEASURES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These add useful chapter-level statistics without introducing any old files.
# FIG102 supplies all-degree totals; FIG103 supplies STEM-degree totals.

fig102_degree_totals <- fig102 %>%
  transmute(
    Year = year_number(.data$Year),
    All_Bachelors = numeric_clean(.data$Bachelors),
    All_Masters = numeric_clean(.data$Masters),
    All_Doctorates = numeric_clean(.data$Doctorate)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(.data$Year))

fig103_stem_totals <- fig103 %>%
  transmute(
    Year = year_number(.data$Year),
    STEM_Bachelors = numeric_clean(.data$Bachelors),
    STEM_Masters = numeric_clean(.data$Masters),
    STEM_Doctorates = numeric_clean(.data$Doctorate)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(.data$Year))

stem_composition <- inner_join(
  fig103_stem_totals,
  fig102_degree_totals,
  by = "Year"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_STEM = .data$STEM_Bachelors +
      .data$STEM_Masters +
      .data$STEM_Doctorates,

    Masters_Doctorate_Ratio =
      .data$STEM_Masters / .data$STEM_Doctorates,

    STEM_Share_Bachelors =
      .data$STEM_Bachelors / .data$All_Bachelors,

    STEM_Share_Masters =
      .data$STEM_Masters / .data$All_Masters,

    STEM_Share_Doctorates =
      .data$STEM_Doctorates / .data$All_Doctorates
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. TABLE 1.01 FIELD SHARES — EXPLICIT 2015–2025 ENDPOINTS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

field_share_metric <- function(
    field,
    degree_prefix,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 2015L,
    latest_year = 2025L
) {
  row <- tab101 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Field) ==
        normalize_label(.env$field)
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier_col <- paste0(
    degree_prefix,
    "_",
    earlier_year
  )

  latest_col <- paste0(
    degree_prefix,
    "_",
    latest_year
  )

  required_cols <- c(
    earlier_col,
    latest_col
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required_cols,
    names(row)
  )

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required TAB101 columns for ",
      degree_prefix,
      ": ",
      paste(
        missing_cols,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "field_dependence",
    section = "International share in selected STEM fields",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = numeric_clean(
      row[[earlier_col]]
    )[[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = numeric_clean(
      row[[latest_col]]
    )[[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. PROJECTION HELPER
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

projection_metric <- function(
    df,
    country,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type = "count",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  country_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      is.finite(.data$value)
    )

  observed <- country_df %>%
    filter(.data$period == "Observed") %>%
    arrange(.data$Year) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  projected <- country_df %>%
    filter(.data$period == "Projected") %>%
    arrange(.data$Year) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  if (nrow(observed) != 1 || nrow(projected) != 1) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "projection",
    section = "Global STEM PhD projections",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = observed$value[[1]],
    first_label = observed$Year[[1]],
    last_value = projected$value[[1]],
    last_label = projected$Year[[1]],
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis,
    projected = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r infographic_ch2_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#     comparison because it is not part of the current FIG207 source file.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (

ch2_levels <- ch2_levels %>%

      ),

    ),

  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch2_india_china_grad <- ch2_fig202 %>%

  )


ch2_region_share_metric <- function(
    region_column,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  region_columns <- setdiff(
    names(ch2_tab201),
    c(
      "Year",
      "Percent Asia"
    )
  )

  tmp <- ch2_tab201 %>%
    mutate(
      Year = year_number(.data$Year),
      across(
        -Year,
        numeric_clean
      ),
      Total = rowSums(
        across(
          all_of(region_columns)
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Value = .data[[region_column]] / .data$Total
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "geography",
    section = "Geographic concentration",
    measure = measure,
    df = tmp,
    column = "Value",
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. 2025/26 ENROLLMENT PROJECTION HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The snapshot reports 2025 year-over-year changes. Apply those changes to the
# actual 2024/25 category counts to reproduce the approved 2025/26 comparison.

CH2_ENROLLMENT_2025 <- c(
  Total = 1177766,
  Undergraduate = 357231,
  Graduate = 488481,
  `Non-Degree` = 37801,
  OPT = 294253
)

ch2_snapshot_change <- function(category) {
  value <- ch2_fig206 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Category) ==
        normalize_label(.env$category)
    ) %>%
    pull(.data$Change)

  if (
    length(value) != 1 ||
    !is.finite(value[[1]])
  ) {
    stop(
      "Expected one current enrollment-change value for `",
      category,
      "`."
    )
  }

  value[[1]]
}


ch2_projection_metric <- function(
    category,
    stat_id,
    measure,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  first_value <- unname(
    CH2_ENROLLMENT_2025[[category]]
  )

  change <- ch2_snapshot_change(
    category
  )

  last_value <- first_value *
    (
      1 +
      change / 100
    )

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "economy",
    section = "Economic contribution and 2025/26 enrollment",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = first_value,
    first_label = 2025,
    last_value = last_value,
    last_label = 2026,
    value_type = "count",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis,
    projected = TRUE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. RECRUITMENT HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CH2_RECRUITMENT_2025_ALL <- bind_rows(
  ch2_fig207 %>%
    transmute(
      Rank = .data$Rank,
      Level = "Undergraduate",
      Priority = .data$Undergraduate_Country,
      Percent = .data$Undergraduate_Value
    ),
  ch2_fig207 %>%
    transmute(
      Rank = .data$Rank,
      Level = "Graduate",
      Priority = .data$Graduate_Country,
      Percent = .data$Graduate_Value
    )
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(.data$Priority),
    nzchar(trimws(.data$Priority)),
    is.finite(.data$Percent)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = 2025L
  )


ch2_recruitment_top_2025 <- function(
    level = c(
      "Undergraduate",
      "Graduate"
    )
) {
  level <- match.arg(level)

  CH2_RECRUITMENT_2025_ALL %>%
    filter(
      .data$Level == .env$level
    ) %>%
    slice_min(
      order_by = .data$Rank,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )
}


ch2_recruitment_metric <- function(
    level = c(
      "Undergraduate",
      "Graduate"
    ),
    stat_id,
    emphasis = TRUE
) {
  level <- match.arg(level)

  current <- ch2_recruitment_top_2025(
    level
  )

  baseline <- CH2_RECRUITMENT_2015_TOP

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "recruitment",
    section = "Recruitment and barriers",
    measure = paste0(
      "Top ",
      tolower(level),
      " recruitment target"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      "CN: ",
      scales::number(
        baseline$Percent[[1]],
        accuracy = 0.1
      ),
      "% (2015)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      current$Priority[[1]],
      ": ",
      scales::number(
        current$Percent[[1]],
        accuracy = 0.1
      ),
      "% (2025)"
    ),
    change = paste0(
      "CN \u2192 ",
      current$Priority[[1]]
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. BARRIER HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch2_reason_metric <- function(
    reason,
    stat_id,
    measure = reason,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch2_fig208 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Reason) ==
        normalize_label(.env$reason)
    )

  if (
    nrow(row) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  periods <- temporal_columns(
    row,
    exclude = "Reason"
  )

  values <- numeric_clean(
    unlist(
      row[periods$column],
      use.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  keep <- is.finite(values)

  periods <- periods[
    keep,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  values <- values[keep]

  if (
    length(values) == 0
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (
    length(values) == 1
  ) {
    return(
      metric_snapshot(
        stat_id = stat_id,
        section_id = "recruitment",
        section = "Recruitment and barriers",
        measure = measure,
        value = values[[1]],
        label = periods$column[[1]],
        value_type = "percent_value",
        emphasis = emphasis
      )
    )
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "recruitment",
    section = "Recruitment and barriers",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = values[[1]],
    first_label = periods$column[[1]],
    last_value = values[[length(values)]],
    last_label = periods$column[[nrow(periods)]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# 9. CODE THE ADDITIONAL TABLE 2.02–2.04 STATISTICS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These remain available in ch2_all_stats, but they are intentionally NOT in
# CH2_SELECTED_STATS because the approved example does not display them.

CH2_TAB202_FIELD_FILES <- list(
  "Engineering" = ch2_tab202a,
  "Math & Computer Science" = ch2_tab202b,
  "Physical & Life Sciences" = ch2_tab202c,
  "Business and Management" = ch2_tab202d,
  "Education" = ch2_tab202e,
  "Fine/Applied Arts" = ch2_tab202f,
  "Health Professions" = ch2_tab202g,
  "Social Sciences" = ch2_tab202h
)

CH2_TAB202_PROPORTION_FIELDS <- c(
  "Engineering",
  "Math & Computer Science",
  "Physical & Life Sciences"
)

ch2_tab202_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  CH2_TAB202_FIELD_FILES,
  function(df, field_name) {
    df %>%
      mutate(
        Year = year_number(.data$Year),
        across(
          -Year,
          numeric_clean
        )
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        -Year,
        names_to = "Country",
        values_to = "Share"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(.data$Share)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Share = if (
          field_name %in% CH2_TAB202_PROPORTION_FIELDS
        ) {
          .data$Share * 100
        } else {
          .data$Share
        },
        Field = field_name
      )
  }
)

ch2_tab202_changes <- ch2_tab202_long %>%
  group_by(
    .data$Country,
    .data$Field
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    .data$Year,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n() >= 2
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    FirstYear = first(.data$Year),
    LastYear = last(.data$Year),
    First = first(.data$Share),
    Last = last(.data$Share),
    Change = .data$Last - .data$First,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ch2_tab202_example_metric <- function(
    country,
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch2_tab202_changes %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$Field == .env$field
    )

  if (
    nrow(row) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "field_shift",
    section = "How the field mix is shifting",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      " — ",
      tolower(field)
    ),
    first_value = row$First[[1]],
    first_label = row$FirstYear[[1]],
    last_value = row$Last[[1]],
    last_label = row$LastYear[[1]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch2_grad_tvh_metric <- function(
    df,
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tmp <- df %>%
    transmute(
      Year = year_number(.data$Year),
      Temporary = numeric_clean(
        .data$`Temporary visa holders`
      ),
      Domestic = numeric_clean(
        .data$`U.S. citizens and permanent residents`
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Share = .data$Temporary /
        (
          .data$Temporary +
          .data$Domestic
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Share)
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "graduate_tvh",
    section = "Temporary-visa share of graduate enrollment",
    measure = field,
    df = tmp,
    column = "Share",
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch2_tab204b_normalized <- ch2_tab204b %>%
  rename(
    `Social Science` = any_of(
      "Social Sciences"
    )
  )

ch2_doctorate_tvh_metric <- function(
    field,
    stat_id,
    display_name = field,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (
    !field %in% names(ch2_tab204a) ||
    !field %in% names(ch2_tab204b_normalized)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tmp <- inner_join(
    ch2_tab204a %>%
      transmute(
        Year = year_number(.data$Year),
        Domestic = numeric_clean(
          .data[[field]]
        )
      ),
    ch2_tab204b_normalized %>%
      transmute(
        Year = year_number(.data$Year),
        Temporary = numeric_clean(
          .data[[field]]
        )
      ),
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Share = .data$Temporary /
        (
          .data$Temporary +
          .data$Domestic
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Share)
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "doctorate_tvh",
    section = "Temporary-visa share of research doctorates",
    measure = display_name,
    df = tmp,
    column = "Share",
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. BUILD AND EXPORT USING THE GLOBAL 30-ROW PAGINATION RULE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_ch2_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (is_last_page) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Academic-level rows use longitudinal bookends from the ",
        "current international-enrollment-by-level series. The 2025/26 ",
        "enrollment rows apply the reported 2025 year-over-year change to ",
        "the 2024/25 actual category count. The 2015 recruitment priorities ",
        "are hard-coded from the historical recruitment-priorities chart; ",
        "the 2025 priorities and barrier measures use the current snapshot."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 2.01–2.08 and ",
        "Table 2.01, plus the report’s current international-enrollment-by-",
        "academic-level series. Historical 2015 recruitment values are from ",
        "the supplied recruitment-priorities chart."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch2_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf("%02d", page_number)
    ),
    chapter_number = 2,
    title = "WHO COMES TO THE US TO STUDY?",
    subtitle = "The changing sources of America’s international STEM talent",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest = "Latest or<br>projected value",
      Change = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}


ch2_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data = ch2_selected,
  build_page = build_ch2_page,
  name = "infographic_ch2_by_the_numbers"
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch2_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
```

```{r infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ch3_degree_population_metric <- function(
    df,
    population,
    degree,
    display_degree,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!degree %in% names(df)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "degree_work",
    section = "From degree to STEM work",
    measure = paste0(
      population,
      " ",
      display_degree,
      " holders employed in STEM"
    ),
    df = df,
    column = degree,
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

  select(
    .data$Company,
    all_of(ch3_h1b_year_columns)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -.data$Company,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Approvals"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(.data$Year),
    Approvals = replace_na(
      numeric_clean(.data$Approvals),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ch3_h1b_total,
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Share = .data$Approvals / .data$Total
  )


ch3_h1b_top10 <- ch3_h1b_company_long %>%
  group_by(.data$Year) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = .data$Approvals,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Share = sum(
      .data$Approvals,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) /
      first(.data$Total),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ch3_h1b_company_metric <- function(
    company,
    display_name,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch3_h1b_company_long %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Company) ==
        normalize_label(.env$company),
      .data$Year %in% c(
        2017,
        2025
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(.data$Year)

  if (
    nrow(row) != 2
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "h1b",
    section = "H-1B employer concentration",
    measure = display_name,
    first_value = row$Share[[1]],
    first_label = row$Year[[1]],
    last_value = row$Share[[2]],
    last_label = row$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch3_founder_origin_metric <- function(

) {

ch3_ai_staffing_metric <- function(
    company,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- fig310 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Company) ==
        normalize_label(.env$company)
    )

  if (
    nrow(row) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "ai_staffing",
    section = "Where leading AI companies staff research",
    measure = company,
    earlier = scales::percent(
      row$`United States`[[1]],
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    latest = scales::percent(
      row$China[[1]],
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    change = scales::percent(
      row$`Rest of World`[[1]],
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. BUILD PAGES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_ch3_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  # Page 2 is not a time comparison. Figure 3.10 is a geographic composition
  # chart, so relabel the three value columns accordingly.
  page_column_labels <- if (
    page_number == 2
  ) {
    c(
      Earlier = "United<br>States",
      Latest  = "China",
      Change  = "Rest of<br>world"
    )
  } else {
    c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest  = "Latest value",
      Change  = "Change"
    )
  }

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the first and latest available ",
        "observations in the current source series. H-1B company rows compare ",
        "2017 with 2025, matching current Table 3.03. Figure 3.10 rows are a ",
        "geographic composition snapshot rather than a time comparison; the ",
        "three value columns therefore report the United States, China, and ",
        "rest-of-world shares."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 3.01–3.10 and ",
        "Tables 3.01–3.03. Figure 3.06 and Table 3.03 are derived from the ",
        "same employer-level H-1B source used for Figure 3.05."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 3,
    title = "FROM EDUCATION TO THE WORKFORCE: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "International talent across research, employment, and AI",
    column_labels = page_column_labels,
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. EXPORT THROUGH THE GLOBAL 30-ROW PAGINATION RULE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data = ch3_selected,
  build_page = build_ch3_page,
  name = "infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers"
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch3_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
```

```{r infographic_ch4_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
bookend_category_metric <- function(
    df,
    id_col,
    category,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c(id_col, category) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  rows <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[id_col]]),
      is.finite(
        numeric_clean(
          .data[[category]]
        )
      )
    )

  if (nrow(rows) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  first <- rows %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  last <- rows %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = numeric_clean(
      first[[category]]
    )[[1]],
    first_label = as.character(
      first[[id_col]]
    )[[1]],
    last_value = numeric_clean(
      last[[category]]
    )[[1]],
    last_label = as.character(
      last[[id_col]]
    )[[1]],
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


fixed_year_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    earlier_year,
    latest_year,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c("Year", column) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$earlier_year
    )

  latest <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$latest_year
    )

  if (
    nrow(earlier) != 1 ||
    nrow(latest) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = earlier[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = latest[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


benchmark_text_metric <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    baseline_text,
    comparison_text,
    change_text,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    earlier = baseline_text,
    latest = comparison_text,
    change = change_text,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

fig407_long <- fig407 %>%

      .data$entry_2003,

    ),
    names_to = "CohortCode",
    values_to = "Share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = dplyr::recode(
      .data$CohortCode,
      entry_2003 = "2003/04",
      entry_2011 = "2011/12"
    ),
    CohortOrder = dplyr::recode(
      .data$CohortCode,
      entry_2003 = 1L,
      entry_2011 = 2L
    )
  )


retention_metric <- function(
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- fig407_long %>%
    filter(
      .data$field == .env$field,
      is.finite(.data$Share)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$CohortOrder
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "persistence",
    section = "STEM persistence and attrition",
    measure = paste0(
      field,
      ": graduated in entry field"
    ),
    first_value = row$Share[[1]],
    first_label = row$Cohort[[1]],
    last_value = row$Share[[2]],
    last_label = row$Cohort[[2]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. INTERNATIONAL MOBILITY — FIGURES 4.09–4.10
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

mobility <- fig409 %>%
  rename(
    Country = 1
  ) %>%
  select(
    -any_of(
      "Grand Total"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -Country,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(
        .data$Year
      )
    ),
    Share = numeric_clean(
      .data$Share
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(.data$Year),
    is.finite(.data$Share)
  )


mobility_snapshot <- function(
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- mobility %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country ==
        .env$country
    ) %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$Year,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_snapshot(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "mobility",
    section = "International student mobility",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      ": tertiary students studying abroad"
    ),
    value = row$Share[[1]],
    label = row$Year[[1]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


flow_metric <- function(
    country,
    display_country = country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!country %in% names(fig410)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tmp <- fig410 %>%
    transmute(
      Year = .data$Year,
      Flow = .data[[country]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Flow)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  first <- tmp %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  last <- tmp %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  first_m <- first$Flow[[1]] / 1e6
  last_m <- last$Flow[[1]] / 1e6
  delta_m <- last_m - first_m

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "mobility",
    section = "International student mobility",
    measure = paste0(
      display_country,
      ": net international-student flow"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      sprintf(
        "%.2fM",
        first_m
      ),
      " (",
      first$Year[[1]],
      ")"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      sprintf(
        "%.2fM",
        last_m
      ),
      " (",
      last$Year[[1]],
      ")"
    ),
    change = sprintf(
      "%+.2fM",
      delta_m
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. BUILD PAGES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_ch4_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the stated earlier and latest ",
        "cohorts or years. Table 4.03 rows deliberately compare 2005 with ",
        "2024 to match the published table. Benchmark rows compare the United ",
        "States with the named OECD benchmark rather than change over time. ",
        "Arrow colors indicate numeric direction only, not whether the authors ",
        "consider the difference or change positive or negative."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 4.01–4.10 and ",
        "Tables 4.01–4.04. See the cited figures and tables for full source ",
        "information."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch4_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 4,
    title = "BUILDING TALENT AT HOME: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "Performance, spending, persistence, and international mobility",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest  = "Latest or<br>comparison value",
      Change  = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}

ch4_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data = ch4_selected,
  build_page = build_ch4_page,
  name = "infographic_ch4_by_the_numbers"
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch4_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
```

```{r infographic_ch5_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ch5_fixed_year_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    earlier_year,
    latest_year,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c("Year", column) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$earlier_year
    )

  latest <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$latest_year
    )

  if (
    nrow(earlier) != 1L ||
    nrow(latest) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = earlier[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = latest[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch5_slug <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "[^a-z0-9]+",
      "_"
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "^_|_$",
      ""
    )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CONFERENCE LEADERSHIP — TABLE 5.01
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table 5.01 is raw conference/country/year data. For each venue, use the first
# and last year in which both the United States and China are observed.

conference_two_country_series <- function(
    conf
) {
  tab501 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$conference) ==
        normalize_label(.env$conf),
      .data$country %in% c(
        "United States",
        "China"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Year = .data$year,
      Country = .data$country,
      Share = .data$share
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$Country,
      values_from = .data$Share
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$`United States`),
      is.finite(.data$China)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}


conference_country_metric <- function(
    conf,
    display_conf,
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tmp <- conference_two_country_series(
    conf
  )

  if (
    nrow(tmp) < 1L ||
    !country %in% names(tmp)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "research",
    section = "Research leadership",
    measure = paste0(
      display_conf,
      ": ",
      country,
      " share of accepted author affiliations"
    ),
    first_value = tmp[[country]][[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp[[country]][[nrow(tmp)]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[nrow(tmp)]],
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

rd_type_metric <- function(
    country,
    research_type,
    display_measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 1994L,
    latest_year = 2024L
) {
  tmp <- tab503 %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$`Research Type` == .env$research_type,
      .data$Year %in% c(
        .env$earlier_year,
        .env$latest_year
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "rd",
    section = "R&D scale and composition",
    measure = display_measure,
    first_value = tmp$`USD, PPP conv, BN`[[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp$`USD, PPP conv, BN`[[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "currency_billions",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


rd_performer_metric <- function(
    country,
    category,
    display_measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 1994L,
    latest_year = 2024L
) {
  tmp <- tab504 %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$Category == .env$category,
      .data$Year %in% c(
        .env$earlier_year,
        .env$latest_year
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "rd",
    section = "R&D scale and composition",
    measure = display_measure,
    first_value = tmp$USD_PPP_BN[[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp$USD_PPP_BN[[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "currency_billions",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# Construct Table 5.03 totals directly from the displayed component series.
rd_totals <- tab503 %>%
  group_by(
    .data$Year,
    .data$Country
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(
      .data$`USD, PPP conv, BN`,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


rd_total_metric <- function(
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 1994L,
    latest_year = 2024L
) {
  tmp <- rd_totals %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$Year %in% c(
        .env$earlier_year,
        .env$latest_year
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "rd",
    section = "R&D scale and composition",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      ": total R&D spending"
    ),
    first_value = tmp$Total[[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp$Total[[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "currency_billions",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

critical_patent_metric <- function(
    df,
    country_column,
    country_label,
    technology,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (
    !all(
      c(
        "Year",
        country_column
      ) %in% names(df)
    )
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tmp <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year %in% c(
        2014L,
        2024L
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "critical_patents",
    section = "Patents in critical technologies",
    measure = paste0(
      country_label,
      ": ",
      technology
    ),
    first_value = tmp[[country_column]][[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp[[country_column]][[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "count",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

build_ch5_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the stated first and latest ",
        "observations. R&D component and performer rows use the 1994 and 2024 ",
        "bookends shown in Tables 5.03–5.04; critical-technology patent rows ",
        "compare 2014 with 2024; corporate patent rows compare 2005 with 2025. ",
        "Arrow colors indicate numeric direction only, not whether the authors ",
        "consider the change positive or negative."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 5.01–5.08 and ",
        "Tables 5.01–5.06. See the cited figures and tables for full source ",
        "information."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch5_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 5,
    title = "SCIENCE, R&D, AND INNOVATION: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "Research leadership, investment, and patenting",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier<br>value",
      Latest  = "Latest<br>value",
      Change  = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r infographic_ch6_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 2. GENERIC CHAPTER 6 HELPERS

ch6_fixed_year_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    earlier_year,
    latest_year,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c("Year", column) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$earlier_year
    )

  latest <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$latest_year
    )

  if (
    nrow(earlier) != 1L ||
    nrow(latest) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = earlier[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = latest[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch6_series_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    df = df,
    column = column,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch6_sum_series <- function(
    df,
    columns
) {
  row_sum_data(
    df,
    columns
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Total = .data$Value
    )
}


ch6_peak_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$Value,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_first_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_last_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_largest_decline <- function(
    df,
    column
) {
  series <- series_data(
    df,
    column
  )

  if (nrow(series) < 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  candidates <- purrr::map_dfr(
    2:nrow(series),
    function(i) {
      prior <- series[
        1:(i - 1),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      peak <- prior %>%
        slice_max(
          order_by = .data$Value,
          n = 1,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )

      tibble(
        peak_year = peak$Year[[1]],
        peak_value = peak$Value[[1]],
        trough_year = series$Year[[i]],
        trough_value = series$Value[[i]],
        decline = peak$Value[[1]] -
          series$Value[[i]]
      )
    }
  )

  best <- candidates %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$decline,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  list(
    peak = list(
      year = best$peak_year[[1]],
      label = calendar_year_label(
        best$peak_year[[1]]
      ),
      value = best$peak_value[[1]]
    ),
    trough = list(
      year = best$trough_year[[1]],
      label = calendar_year_label(
        best$trough_year[[1]]
      ),
      value = best$trough_value[[1]]
    )
  )
}

ch6_h1b_denial_series <- function(
    approved_df,
    denied_df
) {
  approved <- series_data(
    approved_df,
    "New Approved"
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Approved = .data$Value
    )

  denied <- series_data(
    denied_df,
    "New Denials"
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Denied = .data$Value
    )

  inner_join(
    approved,
    denied,
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
    transmute(
      Year = .data$Year,
      Value = .data$Denied /
        (
          .data$Approved +
            .data$Denied
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}

        c(
          normalize_label("Certified"),
          normalize_label("Certified-Expired")
        )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      StatusClean = dplyr::case_when(
        normalize_label(.data$Status) ==
          normalize_label("Certified") ~
          "Used",

        normalize_label(.data$Status) ==
          normalize_label("Certified-Expired") ~
          "Expired",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data$StatusClean)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      .data$Year,
      .data$StatusClean
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = sum(
        .data$Count,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$StatusClean,
      values_from = .data$Count,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Value = .data$Expired /
        (
          .data$Used +
            .data$Expired
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}


ch6_perm_expired_metric <- function(
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  series <- ch6_perm_expired_series(
    country
  )

  # Match the published Table 6.04 comparison window.
  first <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == 2008L
    )

  last <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == 2024L
    )

  if (
    nrow(first) != 1L ||
    nrow(last) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "permanence",
    section = "Permanent-residence bottleneck",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      ": PERM certifications expiring unused"
    ),
    first_value = first$Value[[1]],
    first_label = 2008L,
    last_value = last$Value[[1]],
    last_label = 2024L,
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch6_wait_endpoint <- function(
    df,
    category,
    year
) {
  row <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$year
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  value <- row[[category]][[1]]

  if (!is.finite(value)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  list(
    year = year,
    value = value
  )
}


ch6_wait_label <- function(
    months
) {
  months <- round(months)

  if (!is.finite(months)) {
    return("—")
  }

  if (months == 0L) {
    return("0 mo")
  }

  years <- months %/% 12
  remainder <- months %% 12

  if (years == 0L) {
    return(
      paste0(
        remainder,
        " mo"
      )
    )
  }

  if (remainder == 0L) {
    return(
      paste0(
        years,
        "y"
      )
    )
  }

  paste0(
    years,
    "y ",
    remainder,
    "m"
  )
}


ch6_wait_change_label <- function(
    first_months,
    last_months
) {
  difference <- round(
    last_months -
      first_months
  )

  if (!is.finite(difference)) {
    return("—")
  }

  sign <- if (difference > 0) {
    "+"
  } else if (difference < 0) {
    "-"
  } else {
    ""
  }

  paste0(
    sign,
    ch6_wait_label(
      abs(difference)
    )
  )
}


ch6_wait_metric <- function(
    df,
    geography,
    category,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  # Match the displayed Table 6.05: 2005 → 2025.
  first <- ch6_wait_endpoint(
    df,
    category,
    2005L
  )

  last <- ch6_wait_endpoint(
    df,
    category,
    2025L
  )

  if (
    is.null(first) ||
    is.null(last)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "permanence",
    section = "Permanent-residence bottleneck",
    measure = paste0(
      geography,
      " ",
      category,
      " green-card wait"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      ch6_wait_label(
        first$value
      ),
      " (2005)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      ch6_wait_label(
        last$value
      ),
      " (2025)"
    ),
    change = ch6_wait_change_label(
      first$value,
      last$value
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch6_fig608_value <- function(
    country
) {
  value <- fig608 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Country) ==
        normalize_label(.env$country)
    ) %>%
    pull(
      .data$`Gap with the native-born`
    )

  if (
    length(value) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(value[[1]])
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  value[[1]]
}

ch6_loss_by_field <- fig609 %>%
  mutate(
    retained = round(
      .data$recipients *
        .data$stay_rate_10yr
    ),
    lost = .data$recipients -
      .data$retained,
    lost_share = 1 -
      .data$stay_rate_10yr
  )


ch6_total_recipients <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$recipients,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_retained <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$retained,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_lost <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$lost,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_lost_share <- if (
  ch6_total_recipients > 0
) {
  ch6_total_lost /
    ch6_total_recipients
} else {
  NA_real_
}


ch6_loss_metric <- function(
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch6_loss_by_field %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$field) ==
        normalize_label(.env$field)
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "loss",
    section = "Other signals and talent loss",
    measure = paste0(
      field,
      ": US-trained international PhDs after ten years"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      scales::comma(
        row$recipients[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " trained (2012–14)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      scales::comma(
        row$retained[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " retained"
    ),
    change = paste0(
      "-",
      scales::comma(
        row$lost[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " (",
      scales::percent(
        row$lost_share[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      ")"
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

build_ch6_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the stated first and latest ",
        "observations unless otherwise noted. Table 6.03 career-path rows ",
        "compare 1994 with 2024. Table 6.04 PERM-expiration rows compare ",
        "2008 with 2024. Green-card wait rows compare 2005 with 2025 to match ",
        "the published Table 6.05. Figure 6.09 uses the 2012–14 doctorate ",
        "cohorts and estimates retention from published ten-year stay rates. ",
        "Arrow colors indicate numeric direction only, not whether the authors ",
        "consider the change positive or negative."
      ),

      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 6.01–6.09 and ",
        "Tables 6.01–6.05. See the cited figures and tables for full source ",
        "information."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch6_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 6,
    title = "THE RETENTION GAP: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "Why America is losing talent that wants to stay",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest  = "Latest or<br>outcome",
      Change  = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r infographic_source_year_audit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
# ============================================================================
# PUBLICATION QA: SOURCE + ENDPOINT-YEAR AUDIT — CHAPTERS 1–4
#
# The audit reads the actual Earlier / Latest / Change cells sent to the
# infographic tables. It therefore audits the publication output rather than
# independently reconstructing the values.
#
# The CSV is always written. Set INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_SHOW <- TRUE in setup if
# you also want the audit printed at the end of the knitted HTML.
# ============================================================================

if (!exists("INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_SHOW")) {
  INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_SHOW <- FALSE
}


audit_extract_year <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  vapply(
    x,
    function(one) {
      if (
        is.na(one) ||
        !nzchar(trimws(one)) ||
        trimws(one) %in% c("—", "–")
      ) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }

      years <- stringr::str_extract_all(
        one,
        "(?<![0-9])(?:18|19|20|21)[0-9]{2}(?![0-9])"
      )[[1]]

      if (length(years) == 0L) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }

      tail(years, 1)
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

audit_endpoint_rule <- function(chapter, stat_id) {
  dplyr::case_when(

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 1
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 1" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "tab101_") ~
      "Explicit TAB101 2015 → 2025 columns",

    chapter == "Chapter 1" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "proj_") ~
      "Latest observed year → latest projected year",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 2
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "enrollment_") ~
      "2025 actual count + FIG206 year-over-year change → 2026P",

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "top_recruitment_") ~
      "2015 historical recruitment baseline → 2025 FIG207 priority",

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stat_id %in% c(
        "visa_application_process",
        "travel_restrictions",
        "feeling_unwelcome",
        "social_political_environment"
      ) ~
      "Earliest available survey observation → Fall 2025",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 3
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "h1b_") ~
      "2017 → 2025",

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "founder_origin_") ~
      "2025 founder-origin snapshot",

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "ai_staffing_") ~
      "Snapshot composition: US / China / rest of world; not a time comparison",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 4
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stat_id %in% c(
        "pisa_us_vs_japan",
        "pisa_top_math_us_vs_oecd"
      ) ~
      "2022 PISA benchmark comparison; not a time comparison",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "spending_") ~
      "OECD spending benchmark comparison; not a time comparison",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "study_field_") ~
      "Explicit Table 4.03 comparison: 2005 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "study_region_") ~
      "Explicit Table 4.04 comparison: 2005 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "outbound_") ~
      "Latest available outbound-mobility snapshot",

    TRUE ~
      "First nonmissing observation → latest nonmissing observation"
  )
}


audit_years_expected <- function(chapter, stat_id) {
  !(
    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "ai_staffing_")
  ) &
    !(
      chapter == "Chapter 4" &
        stat_id %in% c(
          "pisa_us_vs_japan",
          "pisa_top_math_us_vs_oecd"
        )
    ) &
    !(
      chapter == "Chapter 4" &
        stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "spending_")
    )
}


audit_chapter <- function(
    data,
    chapter,
    source_map
) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      AuditOrder = dplyr::row_number(),

      Source = unname(
        source_map[
          as.character(.data$StatID)
        ]
      ),

      EarlierYear = audit_extract_year(
        .data$Earlier
      ),

      LatestYear = audit_extract_year(
        .data$Latest
      ),

      EndpointRule = audit_endpoint_rule(
        chapter,
        as.character(.data$StatID)
      ),

      YearsExpected = audit_years_expected(
        chapter,
        as.character(.data$StatID)
      ),

      Page = ceiling(
        .data$AuditOrder /
          INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE
      ),

      AuditFlag = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(.data$Source) ~
          "CHECK: source map missing",

        .data$YearsExpected &
          .data$Earlier != "—" &
          is.na(.data$EarlierYear) ~
          "CHECK: earlier cell has no year",

        .data$YearsExpected &
          .data$Latest != "—" &
          is.na(.data$LatestYear) ~
          "CHECK: latest cell has no year",

        !is.na(.data$EarlierYear) &
          !is.na(.data$LatestYear) &
          as.integer(.data$EarlierYear) >
            as.integer(.data$LatestYear) ~
          "CHECK: earlier year is later than latest year",

        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%

    dplyr::transmute(
      Chapter = chapter,
      Page = .data$Page,
      StatID = as.character(.data$StatID),
      Section = as.character(.data$Section),
      Measure = as.character(.data$Measure),
      Source = .data$Source,
      EarlierYear = .data$EarlierYear,
      LatestYear = .data$LatestYear,
      Earlier = as.character(.data$Earlier),
      Latest = as.character(.data$Latest),
      Change = as.character(.data$Change),
      EndpointRule = .data$EndpointRule,
      AuditFlag = .data$AuditFlag,
      AuditOrder = .data$AuditOrder
    )
}


infographic_source_year_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  audit_chapter(
    ch1_data,
    "Chapter 1",
    CH1_AUDIT_SOURCE
  ),

  audit_chapter(
    ch2_selected,
    "Chapter 2",
    CH2_AUDIT_SOURCE
  ),

  audit_chapter(
    ch3_selected,
    "Chapter 3",
    CH3_AUDIT_SOURCE
  ),

  audit_chapter(
    ch4_selected,
    "Chapter 4",
    CH4_AUDIT_SOURCE
  )
) %>%

  dplyr::arrange(
    factor(
      .data$Chapter,
      levels = c(
        "Chapter 1",
        "Chapter 2",
        "Chapter 3",
        "Chapter 4"
      )
    ),
    .data$AuditOrder
  ) %>%

  dplyr::select(
    -.data$AuditOrder
  )

  recursive = TRUE,

)


INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_PATH <- file.path(

)

  infographic_source_year_audit,
  INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_PATH
)

  nzchar(
    infographic_source_year_audit$AuditFlag
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


message(

  INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_PATH,

)

        ),

        "l", "c", "l", "l",
        "l", "c", "c", "l", "l"
      )
    )
  )
}
```
